title: PANDA – Paired Anti-hate Narratives Dataset from Asia: Using an LLM-as-a-Judge to Create the First Chinese Counterspeech Dataset
reasoning: The paper focuses on the development and evaluation of a Chinese counterspeech dataset (PANDA) using LLM-assisted methods. While it deals with hate speech (which can include religious targets) and includes standard 'Ethical Statement' and 'Limitations' sections, it does not have a primary component dedicated to evaluating or benchmarking religion, spiritual traditions, morals, or ethics.
